# Root Server Technical Operations Association
> Root-servers.net provides authoritative information about the DNS root server system, including server identities, operations, governance, and RSSAC publications.

The site documents the global DNS root server system, the organizations operating each root server identity, and technical and governance materials related to root service operations.

## Root Server System
- [Root Server System](https://root-servers.net/): Overview of the DNS root server system and its role in Internet name resolution.
- [Root Server Operators](https://root-servers.net/root-server-operators/): Directory of organizations responsible for operating the thirteen root server identities.
- [Letters](https://root-servers.net/root-server-operators/): Lists the root server letter identities and their corresponding operating organizations.
- [Instances](https://root-servers.net/instances/): Information about globally distributed root server instances and deployment footprint.
- [Maps](https://root-servers.net/maps/): Geographic visualizations of root server instance distribution worldwide.

- [F Root Server](https://root-servers.net/f-root-server/): Operator page for F-root with organization and service details.
- [G Root Server](https://root-servers.net/g-root-server/): Operator page for G-root with organization and service details.
- [H Root Server](https://root-servers.net/h-root-server/): Operator page for H-root with organization and service details.

## Governance and Organization
- [About the Association](https://root-servers.net/about/): Describes the Root Server Technical Operations Association and its purpose.
- [Board of Directors](https://root-servers.net/board-of-directors/): Information about the association’s board leadership and governance.
- [Bylaws](https://root-servers.net/bylaws/): Governing bylaws for the Root Server Technical Operations Association.
- [Contact](https://root-servers.net/contact/): Contact information for the association and root server system inquiries.
- [Privacy Policy](https://root-servers.net/privacy-policy/): Privacy practices for visitors using the root-servers.net website.

## RSSAC and Publications
- [RSSAC Publications](https://root-servers.net/rssac-publications/): Index of Root Server System Advisory Committee publications and reports.
- [RSSAC Caucus](https://root-servers.net/rssac-caucus/): Information about the RSSAC Caucus and its role in root server work.
- [RSSAC Documents](https://root-servers.net/rssac-publications/): Access point for technical advisories, reports, and governance-related publications.
- [Publications Archive](https://root-servers.net/rssac-publications/): Collection of historical and current RSSAC materials.

## Operational Data and Infrastructure
- [Instances](https://root-servers.net/instances/): Data about root server deployment instances across operators and regions.
- [Maps](https://root-servers.net/maps/): Interactive or visual geographic representation of root server infrastructure.
- [Operator Details](https://root-servers.net/root-server-operators/): Consolidated operator information for all root server identities.
- [Root Server Home](https://root-servers.net/): Primary entry point for operational and organizational information.

## Informational Resources
- [About](https://root-servers.net/about/): Background on the association and its stewardship role.
- [Root Server Operators](https://root-servers.net/root-server-operators/): Starting point for understanding who operates each root server letter.
- [RSSAC Publications](https://root-servers.net/rssac-publications/): Technical reading for root server architecture, service, and advisory topics.
- [Contact](https://root-servers.net/contact/): Channel for reaching the association regarding site or organizational matters.
